'

def apply_unified_patch(original_text, patch_text):
    src = original_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    lines = patch_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    out=[]; src_i=0; i=0
    while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('@@'):
        i += 1
    while i < len(lines):
        if not lines[i].startswith('@@'):
            i += 1; continue
        m=re.match(r'@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@', lines[i])
        if not m: raise RuntimeError('bad hunk header: '+lines[i].rstrip())
        old_start=int(m.group(1));
        expected_index=old_start-1
        if expected_index < src_i: raise RuntimeError('overlapping hunk')
        out.extend(src[src_i:expected_index]); src_i=expected_index; i+=1
        while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('@@'):
            line=lines[i]
            if line.startswith(' '):
                expected=line[1:]
                if src_i>=len(src) or src[src_i] != expected:
                    raise RuntimeError(f'context mismatch at source line {src_i+1}')
                out.append(src[src_i]); src_i+=1
            elif line.startswith('-'):
                expected=line[1:]
                if src_i>=len(src) or src[src_i] != expected:
                    raise RuntimeError(f'delete mismatch at source line {src_i+1}')
                src_i+=1
            elif line.startswith('+'):
                out.append(line[1:])
            elif line.startswith('\ No newline at end of file'):
                pass
            elif line.startswith('---') or line.startswith('+++'):
                pass
            else:
                raise RuntimeError('unexpected patch line: '+line[:80])
            i+=1
    out.extend(src[src_i:])
    return ''.join(out)

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('source')
    ap.add_argument('output')
    args=ap.parse_args()
    source=Path(args.source); output=Path(args.output)
    raw=source.read_bytes(); got=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if got != FROM_SHA256:
        raise SystemExit(f'REFUSED predecessor SHA mismatch: {got}')
    original=raw.decode('utf-8')
    patch=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(PATCH_GZIP_B64)).decode('utf-8')
    result=apply_unified_patch(original,patch).encode('utf-8')
    sha=hashlib.sha256(result).hexdigest()
    if sha != TO_SHA256 or len(result) != TO_BYTES:
        raise SystemExit(f'FAILED target mismatch sha={sha} bytes={len(result)}')
    output.write_bytes(result)
    print(f'OK sha256={sha} bytes={len(result)}')

if __name__ == '__main__': main()
